when_baseline_comparison_counts_as_test.confirmatory: Yes — must be included in multiple testing family
when_baseline_comparison_counts_as_test.economic: Separate — economic tests have their own family

hypothesis_family_definition.primary_family: All confirmatory tests for a single hypothesis
hypothesis_family_definition.cross_hypothesis_family: All confirmatory tests across all hypotheses (if tested on same data)
hypothesis_family_definition.baseline_comparisons: Included in hypothesis family when confirmatory

exploratory_logging.required: All exploratory baseline comparisons must be logged
exploratory_logging.format: Experiment ID, baseline ID, metric, value
exploratory_logging.use: Calibration and evidence accumulation, not validation

rules: Baseline family specified before confirmatory execution
All applicable baselines must be reported
Weakest baseline selection after results is prohibited

correction_methods.rationale: Holm controls FWER; BH controls FDR. Both are valid.
